name: preservation
argv:
import subprocess,json
before='6883f1d580d811f7c434d1db4642596362f822b1'; after='be362b7808ea2350a4340cfa2cfde481269037f4'
paths=['SKILL.md','PROVINCE.md','SCORECARD.md','LOG.md','corpus/QUALITY.md','corpus/README.md']
def blob(rev,path): return subprocess.check_output(['git','--no-replace-objects','show',rev+':'+path])
checks={p:blob(after,p).startswith(blob(before,p)) for p in paths}
print(json.dumps({'before':before,'after':after,'priorBytesPreserved':checks},sort_keys=True))
raise SystemExit(0 if all(checks.values()) else 1)
